name: Account registration and session identity
description: Expose public learner registration/login, projected current-user identity and current-session logout with DTO password/locale validation.
requirementBasis: AS-IS reconstructed behavior; not a newly approved specification.

name: Active session and administrative authorization
description: Protected requests require unrevoked unexpired session and ACTIVE user; role-specific handlers require an effective matching role. Cookie is HttpOnly/SameSite=lax, secure=false.
requirementBasis: AS-IS reconstructed behavior; not a newly approved specification.

name: Account-scoped interface locale
description: Read/upsert current-account locale, reject optional stale account header and project fallback vi for missing/unsupported stored locale.
requirementBasis: AS-IS reconstructed behavior; not a newly approved specification.

name: Exact source and revision-specific validation
description: Store exact draft source/hash and persist revision-specific analysis separately from publication. Published/archived source is immutable through import service.
requirementBasis: AS-IS reconstructed behavior; not a newly approved specification.

name: Atomic version publication and audio binding
description: Require current VALIDATED source and selected matching audio; serialize version allocation, retain audit/replay receipt and support explicit version archival.
requirementBasis: AS-IS reconstructed behavior; not a newly approved specification.

name: Durable jobs and bounded recovery
description: PostgreSQL claims/leases/attempt history, owner-attempt completion predicates and bounded retry support recovery. No throughput or exactly-once service-level guarantee was verified.
requirementBasis: AS-IS reconstructed behavior; not a newly approved specification.

name: Local root-bounded object bytes
description: StorageModule binds local adapter. Put writes exclusive temporary file then renames; read/delete resolve lexical paths beneath configured root and reject absolute/traversal keys.
requirementBasis: AS-IS reconstructed behavior; not a newly approved specification.

name: Bound and validate live provider exchange
description: Support fake/direct/routed evaluation, OpenAI Responses, Discovery chat-completions, Microsoft speech and Azure TTS. Helpers bound response bytes/time and adapters validate structured responses.
requirementBasis: AS-IS reconstructed behavior; not a newly approved specification.

name: Persistent privacy-preserving route limits
description: Decorated routes consume fixed-window database buckets keyed by HMAC subject hashes; trusted forwarding requires positive configured hop count. Excess exposes 429 and retry/reset headers.
requirementBasis: AS-IS reconstructed behavior; not a newly approved specification.

name: Local bootstrap, safe errors/logging and guarded recovery
description: API binds loopback with /api/v1 and validation/SafeLogger. Middleware propagates bounded correlation IDs and unexpected exceptions yield generic 500. Backup creates dump/files/hash manifest; restore verifies hashes and empty destinations. No deployment or script execution was performed.
requirementBasis: AS-IS reconstructed behavior; not a newly approved specification.

name: HTTP lỗi được chuẩn hóa bởi exception filter
description: SafeExceptionFilter xử lý HttpException thành JSON gồm code, correlationId, details, message, statusCode và các extra fields. Lỗi không nhận diện trả INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR với thông báo chung và ghi log. Không khẳng định mọi HttpException đều ẩn message nhạy cảm: nhánh HttpException giữ message của exception.
